postings.externalDescription: Senior Manager, IoT Programs Strategy – OneVision Development Transversal Services Job Description Job Title Senior Manager, IoT Programs Strategy – OneVision Development Transversal Services (Container IoT Connected Assets) Location Geneva, Switzerland Overview The Senior Manager, IoT Programs Strategy is accountable of overall solution aspects related to IoT devices non exhaustively including software, hardware, communication means, operational efficiency etc, for Reefer, Dry containers and other upcoming IoT opportunities for MSC Cargo. This role brings them under one strategy, one operating model and one roadmap, and matures them from operational proofs-of-concept into a connected-asset capability with real commercial weight. The role steers multi-location teams in a matrix structure and works closely with Reefer operations, Commercial, Fleet, Ship Management, Digital Innovation, and procurement functions reporting to the Vice President of IT – OneVision Development Transversal Services and IoT Main Responsibilities Strategy Operating Model Own the unified container IoT strategy across reefer and dry, translating business and technical objectives (with application managers and business users) into a multi-year roadmap and prioritized investment plan. Consolidate today's fragmented programs into a single portfolio and define the target operating model — how IoT is organized across hardware, connectivity, software, data and commercial responsibilities. Delivery Rollout Own end-to-end delivery across the portfolio — equipping vessels with connectivity, closing open-sea blind spots in network coverage, and building asset-management tools for connected devices. Move each program from operational proof-of-concept to a mature, supported product, with the organization, processes and service levels behind it. Operational efficiency Drive overall operational solution efficiency both on software and hardware side. Drive timely resolution of issues to restore service both on software and hardware Product Commercial Deliver controlled customer visibility through myMSC, with structured data exports and APIs that integrate with customer and downstream MSC systems. Capture commercial value from connected-asset data and services, with the commercial and customer-experience teams. Data, Analytics Innovation and IA Use IoT data, new technologies and sensor-based POCs to move MSC toward a preventative cargo-care model — spotting and resolving issues early — and to strengthen security monitoring. Eliminate manual data gathering on board, improving safety and automating telemetry collection at sea and on land. Drive AI improvement within IoT such as predictive maintenance, identification of issue resolution and automation Technology, Vendors Connectivity Set and enforce MSC architecture and technology standards across the portfolio. Own the supplier relationship and device-fleet economics together — selecting device, lobying for startegic evoluion, connectivity and platform vendors across satellite and terrestrial communications, and managing procurement (incl negotiation), maintenance, cost optimization and lifecycle. Stakeholder Engagement Governance Bridge IT and the business: establish governance and decision rights with the Digital Innovation function and business stakeholders, clarifying data ownership and the IT–business interface. Align senior stakeholders across reefer operations, commercial, customer experience, fleet and IT on priorities and trade-offs. Team Leadership Organizational Development Lead, mentor and grow the IoT team and program managers across Geneva, Belgium, India and Italy. Participate in recruitment, onboarding and performance management. Skills Strong transversal leadership across multi-location, multicultural teams. Commercial acumen — business cases, monetization and vendor negotiation. Experience leading development teams, with the technical fluency to challenge roadblocks and ensure roadmaps address IT security and technical debt, not just new tools. Data and analytics fluency, with a credible point of view on applied AI. Strong IT background on IOT, Solution development, Azure and telecommunications. Qualifications Experience 8+ years leading connected-product, IoT, telematics or industrial / OT programs combining hardware, connectivity and software at scale (Required) Proven experience setting strategy and an operating model for a fragmented or fast-growing area, and delivering against it (Required) Experience leading and developing teams across multiple locations (Required) Experience working in multi-national matrix organizations (Required) Commercial, budget and vendor management experience (Required) Experience launching customer-facing digital products and APIs (Preferred) Background in container shipping, maritime, logistics or supply chain (Preferred) Familiarity with reefer operations, cold chain, or container equipment and seals (Preferred) Knowledge of Agile methodologies (Preferred) Fluency in English; French and Italian are assets Travel Approximately +25% travel required, including visits to deployment sites and vessels. Reporting Line Reports directly to the Vice President of IT – OneVision Development and Transversal Services, Finance, Fleet, Marketing and IoT .

MSC Mediterranean Shipping Company is a global business engaged in the shipping sector. Present in 155 countries, MSC facilitates international trade between the world’s major economies, and among emerging markets across all continents. Headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, since 1978, MSC is a privately-owned organisation driven by the Aponte family. Today, we continue to focus on caring for customers, employees and the environment. From a one-vessel operation to a globally respected business we have an unfaltering commitment to people that have passion, creativity and willing to make a change. Do you recognize yourself? Then come work with us and be part of MSC’s family. THE POSITION The position sits within the MSC Sustainability Department and supports Social Impact activities across the MSC Cargo Division, contributing to the implementation of the sustainability plan, with a predominant focus on social impacts. The role also supports alignment with relevant national and international standards, industry best practices, and the MSC Cargo Division sustainability strategy. The position supports the integration of social considerations into the MSC Cargo Division’s business agenda, helping to ensure that these topics are progressively embedded across the different areas of the business. In particular, the role will contribute to data collection and analysis activities, including the identification and assessment of the diverse social impacts associated with the MSC Cargo Division. It will also support the implementation of relevant projects at both HQ and local levels. The position will monitor and assess evolving international standards, regulatory developments, and best practices relating to social matters, while staying informed of emerging sustainability topics and approaches to social and economic value creation. In addition, the position will support engagement with key stakeholders on social impacts across both global and local activities. YOUR IMPACT As Sustainability Specialist - Social Impact you will: Liaises with all relevant company departments and business entities within the MSC Cargo Division to contribute to the progressive embedding of social topics across all business areas. Contribute to the development of guiding principles, policies, and initiatives related to social impacts. Contribute to the collection and consolidation of social data across the MSC Cargo Division. Provides analyses on the possible impacts regarding social topics and monitors evolving trends and assesses potential impact on business. Understands international best practices, sustainability standards and requirements and contributes to advance on social topics in the value chain. Support the identification, assessment, and mitigation of sustainability risks and impacts, with a focus on social matters. Monitors and facilitates specific activities and projects across the social dimension both at the central level and at local agencies and sites. Liaises with external stakeholders in contributing to the implementation of joint sustainability projects. Contributes to internal reporting on MSC’s performance across the social dimension and provides monitoring on distance to target. Assists in the development and publication of the annual Sustainability Report and collaborate across departments and businesses entities to develop relevant contents.

Then come work with us and be part of MSC’s family. THE POSITION Coordinate and monitor worldwide second-hand container sales and disposal activities through MSC agencies. The role serves as the central point of contact for agencies regarding container purchase requests, local sales, and scrap transactions. The position ensures accurate processing of sales transactions, invoicing, system updates, reporting, and compliance with company procedures while supporting the optimization of container inventory available for sale. YOUR IMPACT As Container Sale and Disposal Coordinator you will: Coordinate Container Sales Receive, review, and process container purchase requests submitted by MSC agencies for the sale of empty second-hand containers, to shippers or consignees and other approved purchasers through local agencies. Verify container availability and eligibility for sale in accordance with company guidelines. Support agencies in the execution and completion of local sales transactions. Monitor the progress of sales cases and ensure timely closure. Ensure compliance with company policies, contractual conditions, and sales procedures. Ensure sales and disposal transactions are accurately reflected in company systems. Systems and Administration Create manual invoices for third-party container sales. Monitor and validate automatically generated invoices. Investigate and resolve invoicing discrepancies. Generate container sales and disposal reports. Monitor EME transactions and investigate EDI errors. Review equipment activity and container status. Create and maintain SLD and SCR instructions. Update notes, remarks, flags, and contract information. Monitor stock availability through ESR reporting.
